blocks.markdown: such, the essence of an angelic being is pure unselfishness. The ultimate human experience is becoming such an angelic being. It is accomplished by partaking in the cosmic dance-chorus and “rejoicing in His salvation (*bi-yshu‘ato*),” a salvation coming from Him, not us. Because God is infinite, those partaking in the dance-chorus will be “rejoicing,” pointing at Him forevermore.
